info.title: US law-firm websites: Spanish pages, online booking, live chat, structured data, HTTPS and 24/7 intake, by state and practice area: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
US law-firm websites: Spanish pages, online booking, live chat, structured data, HTTPS and 24/7 intake, by state and practice area: What US law-firm websites offer, from 123,823 law-firm websites read (out of 1,101,164 websites visited, 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30): the share that show Spanish-language pages, an online booking tool, live chat, LegalService or Attorney structured data, review markup, HTTPS and a 24/7 intake statement, for every state with at least 100 websites and every practice area with at least 100, plus the number of websites with Spanish pages for each 100,000 Spanish-speaking residents with limited English. No firm is named.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
